subject: CFNotificationCenterGetDarwinNotifyCenter

observation.summary: CoreFoundation ships no standalone Mach-O on macOS 27 (/System/Library/Frameworks/CoreFoundation.framework/CoreFoundation is a broken symlink); its image is resident in the arm64e dyld shared cache (sha256 ecc822c56dbce82d0f151afd7bf8492e91b109944483614f0eaaf377ac7d21da), so otool-exports and nm-symbols both return status=tool-failed against this path. dyld_info resolves the canonical path through the cache and reads the image's LC_DYLD_EXPORTS_TRIE directly. source_artifact is the verbatim dyld_info export dump captured to the cache directory, which is the observed artifact. _CFNotificationCenterGetDarwinNotifyCenter appears in the export trie as a function entry in the image's __TEXT segment (__TEXT spans 0x1808CD000-0x180D5D428 in the cache). Separately, libsystem_notify.dylib, like CoreFoundation, ships no standalone Mach-O on macOS 27 and was read through the same arm64e dyld shared cache via dyld_info. Its export trie contains notify_post and notify_register_check but NOT notify_new, so the Darwin notify centre is built on the check-and-register token API.
observation.raw_output_excerpt:
CF:     0x0003D64C  _CFNotificationCenterGetDarwinNotifyCenter
CF:     0x0003D454  _CFNotificationCenterGetLocalCenter
notify: 0x00003AD8  _notify_post
notify: 0x00000B38  _notify_register_check
(no _notify_new symbol in libsystem_notify.dylib)

claim: CoreFoundation exposes three distinct notification centres - local, distributed and DarwinNotify - and on macOS 27 the DarwinNotify centre is backed by the libsystem_notify notify_post / notify_register_check token API rather than the notify_new API.
